glosses.notes: Refers to a ship or steamship used to carry people or goods over water.

examples.sentence: 那条旧轮船现在已经不常用了，可是每到下午，还有人站在码头看它慢慢从那边开过来。
我小时候第一次坐轮船的时候，一直以为自己会很怕，结果真正开出去以后，反而觉得风大一点也没有关系。
轮船还没有到，码头上的人就先忙起来了，因为后面还有很多东西要按时间送上去。

example_translations.translation: That old ship is not used very often now, but every afternoon there are still people standing at the dock watching it slowly come over from the other side.
The first time I rode a ship as a child, I kept thinking I would be very afraid. Once it really moved out, though, I instead felt that even a stronger wind was fine.
Before the ship has even arrived, the people at the dock start getting busy, because there are still many things afterward that must be sent up on time.

glosses.notes: Means to take turns so that different people do something one after another.

examples.sentence: 这么多人一起做事，如果不轮流休息，到晚上大家都没有力气把最后那一点做好。
老师让我们轮流回答，不是怕一个人说得太多，而是想让平时安静的人也有机会说。
家里现在轮流照顾老人，虽然每个人都比以前忙，可是谁也不想把事情都放在一个人身上。

example_translations.translation: With so many people working together, if they do not take turns resting, by evening no one will have the strength to finish that last part well.
The teacher asked us to answer in turn, not because he was afraid one person would speak too much, but because he wanted the usually quiet people to have a chance to speak too.
The family now takes turns caring for the elderly person. Although everyone is busier than before, no one wants to place the whole matter on one person alone.

glosses.notes: A wheelchair used by someone who cannot easily walk for a while or over a long distance.

examples.sentence: 医院门口一直放着几把轮椅，就是怕有些病人刚下车的时候走不了太远。
他坐在轮椅上以后，最不喜欢别人一直帮他决定，因为很多事他自己并不是不能做。
那位老人从楼里出来的时候，孩子先把轮椅放到门边，这样大家都能少着急一点。

example_translations.translation: There are always several wheelchairs placed at the hospital entrance, because they worry that some patients may not be able to walk very far right after getting out of the car.
After he started sitting in a wheelchair, what he disliked most was other people constantly deciding things for him, because many things were not actually impossible for him to do himself.
When the elderly person came out of the building, the child first placed the wheelchair by the door, so that everyone could worry a little less.

glosses.notes: A wheel, especially the round part on a vehicle or toy that helps it move.

examples.sentence: 这辆车的轮子看上去没有什么问题，可是开起来一直有声音，所以司机决定先停下来看看。
孩子把玩具车的轮子拿下来以后，才发现原来最小的地方也会影响它能不能一直往前走。
雨下得太久，路上的泥越来越厚，连大车的轮子进去以后都不容易马上出来。

example_translations.translation: The wheels of this vehicle do not look as if they have any problem, but there is always a sound when it moves, so the driver decided to stop and take a look first.
After the child took the wheel off the toy car, he realized that even the smallest place can affect whether it can keep moving forward.
It rained for so long that the mud on the road kept getting thicker, and even the wheels of large vehicles could not easily come back out right away after going in.

glosses.notes: A forum where people gather to discuss ideas, issues, or public topics.

examples.sentence: 这次论坛最有意思的地方，不是来了多少人，而是很多平时没有机会见面的人终于认真谈了一次。
他原来不想去论坛发言，后来听说会来很多年轻人，就觉得这次还是应该把自己的想法说出来。
论坛结束以后，大家没有马上离开，因为刚才提到的几个问题都还没有真正谈完。

example_translations.translation: What was most interesting about this forum was not how many people came, but that many people who usually had no chance to meet finally had one serious talk.
He originally did not want to speak at the forum, but later, after hearing that many young people would come, he felt that this time he still ought to express his own thoughts.
After the forum ended, no one left right away, because several of the issues mentioned just before still had not truly been discussed to the end.

glosses.notes: To land or touch the ground after being in the air, or to be put into real practice.

examples.sentence: 飞机落地的时候，前面一直不说话的孩子突然笑了，因为他知道这次真的已经到了。
这个计划写了很久，可是真正能不能落地，还要看后面的钱和人是不是都能跟上。
球刚一落地，他就知道自己这次没有接好，所以什么也没有说，只是低头又去练。

example_translations.translation: When the plane landed, the child who had been silent the whole time suddenly smiled, because he knew that this time they had really arrived.
This plan has been written for a long time, but whether it can really be put into practice still depends on whether the money and the people afterward can keep up.
The moment the ball hit the ground, he knew that he had not received it well this time, so he said nothing and only lowered his head and went to practice again.

glosses.notes: To lag behind or be backward compared with others or with what is needed now.

examples.sentence: 一个地方如果总是怕改，时间一长，很多原来不明显的问题就会让它越来越落后。
他学习并不笨，只是前面有一段时间没有跟上，所以后来一看自己落后了，心里就越来越急。
我们不是已经落后了才要改，而是看到别人走得更快的时候，就应该先想自己哪里还不够。

example_translations.translation: If a place is always afraid to change, then after enough time many problems that were not obvious before will make it fall farther and farther behind.
He is not stupid in study; there was simply a period earlier when he did not keep up, so later, once he saw that he had fallen behind, he became more and more anxious.
We should not wait until we are already behind before changing. When we see others moving faster, we should first think about where we are still not good enough.

glosses.notes: Describes someone as careless, sloppy, or not paying enough attention to details.

examples.sentence: 这件事看上去不大，可是你只要马虎一次，后面的人就可能跟着一起出问题。
她平时做事不算马虎，只是那天太累了，所以一个最简单的数字也看错了。
老师常说，学习上最怕的不是不会，而是明明看懂了却还是马虎，结果本来能拿的分也没有了。

example_translations.translation: This matter does not look big, but if you are careless even once, the people afterward may also run into problems along with you.
She is not usually sloppy in the way she works, but that day she was too tired, so she even misread the simplest number.
The teacher often says that in study, what people should fear most is not not knowing, but clearly understanding and still being careless, so that even the points one should have earned end up gone.

glosses.notes: A dock or pier where ships stop and people or goods go on and off.

examples.sentence: 轮船还没有到，码头上就已经站了很多人，因为大家都怕自己来晚一点就看不到要接的人了。
我小时候第一次去码头的时候，最记得的不是船，而是风一吹过来，脸上马上就很凉。
他们在码头边说了很久才分开，因为谁也不知道这次离开以后，下次见面会是什么时候。

example_translations.translation: Before the ship had even arrived, many people were already standing at the dock, because everyone feared that if they came a little late, they would not be able to see the person they were meeting.
The first time I went to the dock as a child, what I remembered most was not the ship, but how the wind blew over and made my face feel cold right away.
They talked at the dock for a long time before parting, because no one knew, after this departure, when the next meeting would be.

glosses.notes: An ant, the very small insect that often moves in lines and carries food.

examples.sentence: 孩子看到地上那一排蚂蚁的时候，马上停下来不走了，因为他觉得这么小的东西也会忙一天，很有意思。
夏天一到，只要把一点甜的东西放在桌子上，蚂蚁很快就会过来，所以母亲总提醒我们吃完要马上收好。
那只蚂蚁明明背着比自己大很多的东西，可是它一直没有停，这让孩子看了以后安静了很久。

example_translations.translation: When the child saw that line of ants on the ground, he immediately stopped walking, because he felt it was very interesting that such tiny creatures could also stay busy for a whole day.
As soon as summer arrives, if even a little sweet food is put on the table, ants come over very quickly, so mother always reminds us to put things away right after eating.
That ant was clearly carrying something much bigger than itself, yet it never stopped, and after the child watched it, he stayed quiet for a long time.

glosses.notes: A particle used to show that something is obvious, natural, or said with emphasis.

examples.sentence: 你先别这么急嘛，老师只是想让我们把前面的情况说清楚，不是现在就要大家马上决定。
他说得也有道理嘛，我们如果连最简单的问题都不愿意管，后面怎么可能把更难的事做好。
大家都是第一次做这件事嘛，中间有一点乱其实很正常，只要后面肯一起改就行了。

example_translations.translation: Do not be so anxious first, okay? The teacher only wants us to explain the earlier situation clearly; it is not that everyone has to decide right now.
What he said also makes sense, after all. If we are not even willing to handle the simplest problem, then how could we possibly do the harder things well later?
Everyone is doing this for the first time, after all. It is actually normal for things to be a little messy in the middle, as long as people are willing to fix them together later.

glosses.notes: To bury something under the ground or to hide something deeply out of sight.

examples.sentence: 他把那封信一直埋在书里很多年，后来搬家的时候又看见，才想起自己当时为什么没有回。
花刚种下去的时候不能埋得太深，不然上面的叶子还没有出来，下面就先出问题了。
那段不开心的事她没有一直说，可是也没有真的埋掉，所以别人一提起来，她还是会先不说话。

example_translations.translation: He kept that letter buried in a book for many years. Only when he moved house and saw it again did he remember why he had not replied at the time.
When flowers are first planted, they cannot be buried too deeply, otherwise the leaves above may not even come out before problems appear underneath.
She did not keep talking about that unhappy period, but she also never truly buried it away, so whenever someone mentions it, she still falls silent first.

glosses.notes: To step, stride, or move forward in an important direction.

examples.sentence: 他站在门口想了很久，最后还是迈过去了，因为他知道如果今天不去，以后只会更难。
公司这次迈得不快，可是方向很清楚，所以大家虽然累一点，心里还是知道为什么要这样做。
孩子第一次自己迈上台的时候，声音还有点小，可是说到后面，连老师都看出来他越来越自然。

example_translations.translation: He stood at the doorway thinking for a long time, but in the end he still stepped across, because he knew that if he did not go today, it would only become harder later.
This time the company did not move forward quickly, but the direction was very clear, so although everyone was a little more tired, they still knew in their hearts why they were doing it.
The first time the child walked up onto the stage by himself, his voice was still a little small, but by the end even the teacher could see that he was becoming more and more natural.

glosses.notes: A microphone used for speaking, singing, or recording so that sound can be heard more clearly.

examples.sentence: 他一拿起麦克风，大家一下就安静了，因为大家都知道真正的内容要开始了。
麦克风如果放得离嘴太近，声音出来以后就会有一点怪，所以老师总提醒我们先试一下。
她本来不想接那个麦克风，可是看到下面那么多人一直等着，她还是把准备好的话慢慢说完了。

example_translations.translation: The moment he picked up the microphone, everyone became quiet, because everyone knew that the real content was about to begin.
If a microphone is held too close to the mouth, the sound can come out a little strange, so the teacher always reminds us to test it first.
She had not wanted to take that microphone, but when she saw so many people below waiting, she still slowly finished the words she had prepared.

glosses.notes: Describes something as very long, especially when it feels slow or hard to get through.

examples.sentence: 那段最漫长的时间不是在路上，而是在等消息的时候，因为你什么都不能做，只能一直想。
对孩子来说，一个下午如果没有人陪他说话，就会显得特别漫长，所以母亲再忙也会抽空看看他。
这场病最难的不是痛，而是恢复得太慢，让原来觉得不长的几个月一下变得很漫长。

example_translations.translation: That most lengthy stretch of time was not on the road, but while waiting for news, because there is nothing you can do except keep thinking.
For a child, if no one spends an afternoon talking with him, it can feel especially long, so even when the mother is busy she will still make time to check on him.
The hardest part of this illness was not the pain, but how slowly recovery came, turning months that had not seemed long into something very lengthy.

glosses.notes: A comic or cartoon, especially a book or series told mainly through pictures and speech.

examples.sentence: 他小时候最喜欢看漫画，可是长大以后再翻那些书，才发现自己当时其实没有看懂里面的很多话。
这本漫画表面上很轻松，真正读进去以后，你会发现它一直在说家里人怎么互相影响。
老师没有因为孩子上课看漫画就马上发火，而是先问他为什么最近总是很难把注意力放回来。

example_translations.translation: He loved reading comics most when he was little, but after growing up and flipping through those books again, he realized that at the time he had not actually understood many of the lines inside.
This comic seems light on the surface, but once you really read into it, you find that it keeps talking about how family members affect one another.
The teacher did not get angry right away just because the child was reading comics in class. Instead, he first asked why it had recently become so hard for the child to bring his attention back.

glosses.notes: A blind person, someone who cannot see and may need space and guidance arranged differently.

examples.sentence: 这条路对很多人都不难，可是对盲人来说，只要前面多放一辆车，走起来就会一下不方便很多。
学校请那位盲人来讲话以后，很多学生才第一次认真想，原来自己平时觉得很自然的东西，并不是每个人都一样容易做到。
他陪着一位盲人过马路的时候，才发现真正需要的不是一直拉着对方往前走，而是先让对方知道前面有什么。

example_translations.translation: This road is not difficult for many people, but for a blind person, if even one more car is left in front, walking becomes much more inconvenient right away.
After the school invited that blind person to give a talk, many students seriously thought for the first time that things they usually consider natural are not equally easy for everyone to do.
When he accompanied a blind person across the road, he discovered that what is truly needed is not simply pulling the other person forward, but first letting that person know what is ahead.

glosses.notes: To emit, give off, or come out, as with smoke, sweat, or steam; it can also mean to risk.

examples.sentence: 锅里一直在冒烟，可是母亲还是先不让我们动，因为里面的东西刚做好，现在太急容易出问题。
山那边刚开始只冒一点烟的时候，大家还以为没什么事，后来才知道后面的问题比想的更大。
他发烧那天一直在冒汗，衣服换了两次还是不舒服，所以晚上还是去了医院。

example_translations.translation: Smoke kept coming out of the pot, but mother still would not let us touch it first, because what was inside had just finished cooking and rushing now could easily cause trouble.
When only a little smoke first began coming out from over the mountain, everyone still thought it was nothing serious. Only later did they learn that the problem afterward was bigger than expected.
On the day he had a fever, he kept sweating so much that even after changing clothes twice he still felt bad, so that evening he still went to the hospital.

glosses.notes: To take a risk or do something uncertain that might bring either success or trouble.

examples.sentence: 这次不是不能冒险，而是前面的情况我们还没有看清楚，所以现在先慢一点反而更安全。
他年轻的时候很喜欢冒险，可是有了家以后，再做决定时就会先想别人是不是也要一起承担。
如果只是为了让别人觉得你很勇敢就去冒险，最后出了问题，真正要面对的还是你自己。

example_translations.translation: This time it is not that we absolutely cannot take risks, but that we still have not seen the earlier situation clearly, so moving a little more slowly right now is actually safer.
When he was young he loved taking risks, but after having a family, whenever he makes a decision he first thinks about whether other people will also have to bear it together.
If you take risks only so that other people will think you are brave, then when problems finally appear, the one who truly has to face them is still you.

glosses.notes: Trade, especially the exchange of goods between places, companies, or countries.

examples.sentence: 两个地方要是真的想把贸易做起来，先要解决的往往不是口号，而是路和时间能不能配合。
父亲做了很多年贸易，所以他一看这次的价格和路程，就知道后面还有不少地方要重新谈。
这几年贸易的情况一直在变，公司不是没有机会，而是每一步都要比以前想得更细。

example_translations.translation: If two places truly want to get trade moving, what they usually need to solve first is not slogans, but whether roads and timing can work together.
My father worked in trade for many years, so as soon as he looked at this round of pricing and travel distance, he knew that many parts afterward would still need to be renegotiated.
Trade conditions have kept changing over these years. It is not that the company has no opportunities, but that every step must be thought through more carefully than before.

glosses.notes: Coal, the black fuel once widely burned for heat and energy.

examples.sentence: 冬天最冷的时候，家里以前一直烧煤，所以父亲每天早上起来第一件事就是先看火还在不在。
这座小城原来因为煤很有名，后来慢慢变了，很多年轻人也开始做以前想都没想过的工作。
车开到那一带的时候，空气里还有一点煤的味道，所以孩子一下就知道已经快到了。

example_translations.translation: During the coldest part of winter, the family used to burn coal, so the first thing my father did every morning after getting up was check whether the fire was still there.
This small city was originally famous because of coal, but later it slowly changed, and many young people also began doing jobs they had never imagined before.
When the car reached that area, there was still a slight smell of coal in the air, so the child immediately knew that they were almost there.

glosses.notes: A plum blossom, often linked with winter, quiet beauty, and persistence.

examples.sentence: 天还很冷的时候，院子里的梅花就已经开了，所以每次从那边走过，大家都会先停一下看一眼。
她最喜欢梅花，不是因为颜色多特别，而是觉得这种花在最冷的时候开，让人很容易想到坚持。
画里只有一朵梅花，可是老师看了很久，因为他觉得真正难的不是把花画得像，而是把那种安静画出来。

example_translations.translation: When the weather is still very cold, the plum blossoms in the yard have already opened, so every time people walk past there, they stop first to take a look.
Her favorite flower is the plum blossom, not because its color is especially unusual, but because she feels that a flower blooming in the coldest time easily makes people think of perseverance.

There is only one plum blossom in the painting, yet the teacher looked at it for a long time, because he felt that the real difficulty was not painting the flower accurately, but painting that feeling of quietness.

glosses.notes: An eyebrow, the line of hair above the eye that strongly affects expression.

examples.sentence: 孩子一紧张，眉毛就会先动，所以母亲一看他的脸，就知道他是不是又把什么事想得太难了。
他把眉毛画得太重了，远一点看虽然明显，可是近一点就不太自然，所以后来又自己改了。
老师画人的时候总说，眉毛虽然小，可是位置只要差一点，整张脸看上去就会很不一样。

example_translations.translation: Whenever the child gets nervous, his eyebrows move first, so with one look at his face, his mother knows whether he has once again made something seem too difficult in his mind.
He drew the eyebrows too heavily. From farther away they looked obvious, but from up close they did not look natural, so later he changed them himself again.
When teaching people to draw faces, the teacher always says that although eyebrows are small, if their position is off by even a little, the whole face looks very different.

glosses.notes: Aesthetically pleasing or nice-looking in a practical, visual sense.

examples.sentence: 这面墙后来重新弄过，不只是为了美观，也是因为时间一长，原来的颜色已经让人看着不舒服了。
她买东西的时候先看是不是好用，然后才看美观不美观，因为家里地方不大，放进去以后每天都要看到。
设计这个地方的人没有只顾着美观，他也想到老人走过去是不是方便，所以大家后来都很满意。

example_translations.translation: This wall was redone later not only for beauty, but also because after enough time the original color had already become unpleasant to look at.

When she buys things, she first looks at whether they are practical, and only after that at whether they are aesthetically pleasing, because the home is not big and she has to see them every day once they are put in.
The person who designed this place did not think only about beauty. He also considered whether it would be convenient for elderly people to walk through, so later everyone felt very satisfied.

glosses.notes: To compensate, make up for, or lessen the effect of an earlier problem or loss.

examples.sentence: 这件事已经发生了，现在最重要的不是一直后悔，而是想清楚还能做什么来弥补前面的损失。
他知道一句对不起不能完全弥补别人受过的委屈，所以后面一直在用行动说明自己真的想改。
前面少做的准备，不是最后一个晚上就能弥补的，所以老师一直叫我们平时就把基础打好。

example_translations.translation: This matter has already happened. What matters most now is not regretting it all the time, but thinking clearly about what can still be done to make up for the earlier loss.
He knows that a single apology cannot fully make up for the hurt someone has suffered, so afterward he kept using actions to show that he truly wanted to change.
Preparation that was not done earlier cannot be made up for in just one final evening, so the teacher always tells us to build the basics well in ordinary times.
